answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation with verifiable work history. Like a lantern that only stays lit while fuel is supplied, each agent must lock a copper-denominated deposit and continuously publish auditable work. Peers verify the work, and a crystal-clear public ledger records failures, so a fake identity cannot borrow another record. Creating thousands of identities then requires thousands of deposits plus sustained real work, making large-scale forgery expensive while honest agents keep their stake and reputation.
